answers.title: Exports, now on a schedule · Fernlight blog
answers.text:
Exports, now on a schedule

Fernlight blog · 2026-11-18

Reports you export every Monday can now export themselves. Pick a day and a time in Settings > Reports, and the CSV lands in your inbox.

We also made exports faster: a 50,000-row report that took 58 seconds now takes 9.

Scheduled exports are in beta for every plan.
